narrative.overview:
TradeTwin is a work surface for a live trade change, not a promotional dashboard. The implementation treats the interface like a clear piece of trade paperwork: a dark green rail establishes the working context, a cool-white sheet carries the case, and aligned columns keep configuration, evidence, cost, and next action readable together. The visual world is compact, quiet, and operational; the first viewport leads with the case and its delta rather than a welcome hero.

The code-led Operate build uses the trade-paperwork-clarity direction from `.impeccable/surfaces/src-app-tsx.md`: cold whites, ink greens, pale blue/amber/red states, one-pixel rules, and small consistent control radii. It keeps provenance visible through synthetic-data callouts, evidence-page drawers, model badges, and status pills. The landed A surface adds a queue-first entry without replacing the focused single-case work surface: the queue compares derived state, then the detail view carries configuration, evidence, bill, and response in one reading order. KnowledgeWorkspace extends the same ledger language to indexed sources, searchable entries, explicit local/live/fallback modes, and inline citations without introducing a second visual world. This finish-review sync records the built world rather than replacing it with a new visual direction. It is a record of the implemented UI, not a claim that accessibility or production visual QA is complete. Source evidence: `src/styles.css` custom properties and selectors; `src/App.tsx`, `src/components/CaseQueue.tsx`, `src/components/KnowledgeWorkspace.tsx`, and `src/queueUtils.ts` for queue, workspace, evidence, knowledge, audit, and settings behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Dark green navigation rail with a white, sticky utility bar.
Paper-like panels made from flat surfaces, hairline borders, and restrained shadows.
Compact information hierarchy: an observed 8–14px metadata ladder, 16–24px section and metric titles, and a 25–35px case heading.
Semantic state color is reserved for retest, reuse, update, review, warning, model, and synthetic-data cues.
Configuration comparison and evidence-page references are the signature interactions.
Queue-first case discovery with visible status text, derived change chips, explicit unknown fees, and a single “进入案件” action.
Detail navigation and unsaved-change guards preserve the case context while the user moves between configuration, evidence, bill, and quote.
KnowledgeWorkspace keeps index status, six public source entries, searchable knowledge rows, and research provenance in the same paper-ledger hierarchy.
Inline research citations, separate asOf/checkedAt dates, and explicit local/live/fallback labels make evidence status scannable without overstating connectivity.

rules.name: The State-First Color Rule
rules.body: Color must explain a workflow state or a provenance signal before it decorates a surface; retest, reuse, update, review, model, and synthetic data keep their distinct low-saturation treatments.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: Keep the working sheet light and legible; reserve the deepest green for navigation and high-confidence action hierarchy.

rules.name: The Compact Ledger Rule
rules.body: Use the smallest readable size for metadata and state labels, but preserve a clear jump to 16–18px panel titles and the 25–35px case heading.

rules.name: The Task-Order Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens, preserve the sequence of case context → configuration → bill → evidence/conversation; responsive stacking is a workflow decision, not a cosmetic collapse.

rules.name: The Queue Truth Rule
rules.body: Queue status, change chips, fee labels, and sort order must come from the case record and deterministic result; unknown is a visible state, never a zero fallback.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Borders and paper tonal contrast carry normal hierarchy; stronger shadows appear only for notices, drawers, dialogs, and focused interaction.

rules.name: The Hairline Boundary Rule
rules.body: Use a one-pixel separator to expose a relationship or state change; do not replace every boundary with a shadow.

rules.name: The Guarded Save Rule
rules.body: A downstream conversation, option, or quote action may run only after the current draft has saved successfully; preserving the user's input is part of the component state, not a notification afterthought.

rules.name: The Evidence Status Rule
rules.body: A research card must make it obvious whether the answer came from local index, validated live search, or a fallback; no green treatment may imply live connectivity when checkedAt is null.

dos: Do use the existing green-on-paper palette and semantic status colors for real workflow state.
Do keep evidence, page number, source text, and synthetic provenance visible near the conclusion they support.
Do preserve the 1px border and compact spacing rhythm before reaching for stronger elevation.
Do keep focus-visible outlines, labeled fields, semantic buttons, loading states, and reduced-motion behavior present in new surfaces.
Do preserve the #dialog-root portal, inert siblings, focus restoration, Escape close, mobile three-step workflow, and readable audit summaries.
Do keep the model mode, fallback state, and “演示数据环境” treatment visible whenever generated output is shown.
Do keep queue search, status filters, fee/lead-time labels, and customer changes derived from the same case record; show unknown cost explicitly.
Do move from queue comparison into a focused case and retain the active queue conditions when returning.
Do keep KnowledgeWorkspace package counts, source scope, full entry provenance, asOf/checkedAt, and research mode visible near the answer they qualify.
Do use native disclosure and keyboard-visible focus for public sources and entry rows; let Chinese, English, German, and long citation text wrap within the panel.
donts: Don't introduce a marketing hero, decorative dashboard graphic, paper texture, stamp motif, or gradient that the implementation does not use.
Don't use the primary green as a generic decoration when amber/red/blue state semantics are required.
Don't turn synthetic reports, planning fees, or model output into an unqualified certification or delivery promise through visual emphasis.
Don't widen the sidebar or add a second navigation system without preserving the 240px/220px rail behavior and 860px drawer transition.
Don't claim complete accessibility or production polish from this source-derived record; verify new changes against the actual UI.
Don't force a dense table below the 1024px queue breakpoint, or hide the Menu/X control, drawer scroll, focus loop, Escape close, or inert behavior on mobile.
Don't discard dirty configuration when save fails, and don't let chat, option selection, or quote generation continue after a failed automatic save.
Don't label a local index result as 已联网, or use a source index URL as if it were a citation from the current web search.
Don't collapse canonical source IDs and same-domain supplemental pages into one provenance label, and don't let a missing checkedAt imply a fresh review.
